item.title: Mastering Grasshopper: From Basics to Building-Scale Simulations
item.description: A comprehensive guide to leveraging Grasshopper’s visual programming environment — from first components to performance-optimized building designs. How we use parametric design to reshape architecture from the earliest sketches.

item.title: Dynamo to Grasshopper: An Evolution in Design Thinking
item.description: For architects moving from Revit and Dynamo into Rhino and Grasshopper, the shift is more than learning new software — it is a fundamental change in design thinking. Here is what we learned from making that evolution in our practice.
